problems.what: for sleep hypnosis (not 'if you are using this page to help you go to sleep'); a stray space where the link was
problems.replace: If you are using this page to help you go to sleep, use Nimja's sleep playlist .
problems.with: If you want sleep hypnosis, use Nimja's sleep playlist.

problems.what: decide whether to begin; one purpose
problems.replace: Preview, choose a purpose, decide to start.
problems.with: Preview, choose one purpose, decide whether to start.

problems.what: replaced by no-trance contact
problems.replace: eyes open or with no trance contact replacement.
problems.with: eyes open, or replaced by no-trance contact.

problems.what: move (not 'move on')
problems.replace: move on, imagine,
problems.with: move, imagine,

problems.what: the mind doesn't owe anybody a movie
problems.replace: movement, knowing etc.
problems.with: movement, knowing etc. The mind doesn’t owe anybody a movie.

problems.what: which area or inner voice wants attention; what support is needed
problems.replace: Ask yourself where in your body (and/or voice) you need to stretch or release and what you need by way of support to do this.
problems.with: Ask yourself which area, or which inner voice, wants attention, and what support is needed.

problems.what: the support carries 1% more effort, as if floating without losing contact (Emulate had you use 1% more effort)
problems.replace: Use only 1% more effort than it takes to simply rest your weight on the support, or use the same weight and pressure.
problems.with: Notice where your weight is carried, and let the support carry 1% more of your effort, as if floating without losing contact, or keep the same weight and pressure.

problems.what: alternate attention: ordinary awareness on the inhale, the support on the exhale
problems.replace: spending more time on in-breaths in normal awareness, and on out-breaths focusing on the support.
problems.with: turning your attention toward normal awareness on the in-breath and toward the support on the out-breath.

problems.what: keep the support, then return
problems.replace: Return to normal weight and firm contact as you choose.
problems.with: Keep the support, come back to the weight and firm contact you choose, and return.

problems.what: what becomes easier to hear (a close call the second reader named)
problems.replace: What can you hear now?
problems.with: What becomes easier to hear?

problems.what: noticing where attention lands between repetitions
problems.replace: over and over, until suddenly, stop the rhythm.
problems.with: over and over, noticing where your attention lands in between, until suddenly, stop the rhythm.

problems.what: notice the first quiet beat, without trying to become blank
problems.replace: This will bring about its own rhythm, the first one that appears - do not try and make it blank.
problems.with: Notice the first quiet beat - do not try and make your mind blank.

problems.what: let ordinary rhythm resume and return
problems.replace: Then go back to using a normal rhythm.
problems.with: Then let your normal rhythm come back, and return.

problems.what: 'suddenly'
problems.replace: until suddenly, stop the rhythm.
problems.with: then stop the rhythm.

problems.what: one concern with several strands; yarn unwinding, bubbles settling, knots placed beside you ('have some by you' is new)
problems.replace: A quick exercise for when you have several concerns going on. Visualise each one as a strand of yarn, or even better, have some by you to help.
problems.with: A quick exercise for when one concern has several strands. Imagine yarn unwinding, bubbles settling, or knots placed where you can see them beside you.

problems.what: count only the strands you set down; nothing is erased; which needs warmth, protection or action
problems.replace: How many did you end up with?
problems.with: Count only the strands you actually set down; nothing is erased. Which one needs warmth, protection, or action?

problems.what: keep one useful strand; return (not 'come back to this page')
problems.replace: Now pick one that is important to do something about, put the others somewhere you can see them, and come back to this page.
problems.with: Now keep one useful strand, put the others somewhere you can see them, and return.

problems.what: who or what needs to speak (not whoever you want to speak to)
problems.replace: until you are in a place where you can directly speak to whoever/whatever it is you want to speak to.
problems.with: until you are in a place where whoever or whatever needs to speak can speak.

problems.what: notice a detail without assigning hidden meaning
problems.replace: Observe what you want to observe,
problems.with: Notice a detail without giving it a hidden meaning,

problems.what: the mystery is how the scene develops
problems.replace: just don't make it into a "what are they going to do to you?" kind of thing.
problems.with: the mystery is how the scene develops, so don't make it into a "what are they going to do to you?" kind of thing.

problems.what: imagine warmth, steadiness or attention spreading (not 'the current condition')
problems.replace: Sense the current condition and sense it radiating outward to the next area
problems.with: Sense what is already there, and imagine warmth, steadiness or attention radiating outward to the next area

problems.what: without claiming medical repair; does the body want contact, space, words or ordinary care
problems.replace: Sense what the body needs to feel better, without thinking of medical terms.
problems.with: Notice what changes, without claiming any medical repair. Does the body want contact, space, words, or ordinary care?

problems.what: return (not 'repeat the process')
problems.replace: and repeat the process.
problems.with: and return.

problems.what: patient care (unhurried), not working with a patient
problems.replace: First get ready as if you were going to work with a patient. Time, place, tools and boundaries.
problems.with: First get ready for some patient, unhurried care: time, place, tools and boundaries.

problems.what: let the signal, feeling or younger state come only as close as is welcome
problems.replace: When you invite them in, the signal, the feeling or the younger state to come as close as you want them to be.
problems.with: Let the signal, the feeling or the younger state come only as close as is welcome.

problems.what: ask before responding; reconnect only where welcome; rest and reassess
problems.replace: Ask them what they need, wait and see if you want to reconnect with them. If not, rest and see again.
problems.with: Ask before you respond, wait, reconnect only where that’s welcome, rest, and see again.

problems.what: an inner adult or a borrowed function can help
problems.replace: speak to them.
problems.with: let that help.

problems.what: 'good as you', not 'as good as you can'
problems.replace: The goal is to be as good as you can and not erase your history.
problems.with: Aim for “good as you,” not an erased history.

problems.what: close the workspace (not 'as you would with a patient')
problems.replace: Finally, close as you would with a patient.
problems.with: Finally, close the workspace.

problems.what: a quality you understand (warmth, boundary, steadiness, curiosity, dignity), 1% more access through posture, voice or attention; never becoming someone else
problems.replace: Choose someone or something who has a characteristic you want to adopt. Close your eyes and imagine them. Now imagine yourself becoming them, standing, walking and talking like them, just 1% more, or if you are uncomfortable with this, simply observe them, but in either case be aware of how you now have more access to that quality.
problems.with: Choose a quality you understand, like warmth, a boundary, steadiness, curiosity or dignity. Close your eyes and imagine your posture, voice or attention with just 1% more access to it, or if you are uncomfortable with this, simply observe it.

problems.what: to strengthen access, not replace identity
problems.replace: Repeat a few times.
problems.with: Repeat a few times, to strengthen your access to it, not to become someone else.

problems.what: how would the quality meet today's situation
problems.replace: Now think of a situation you want to use that characteristic in.
problems.with: How would that quality meet the situation you’re in today?

problems.what: keep the quality and one useful action, release the role, 'I am myself', return
problems.replace: Finally let go of the person/thing, but keep the characteristic, and say to yourself "I am me", and notice how you have increased access to the characteristic you wanted.
problems.with: Finally keep the quality and one useful action, let go of the role, say to yourself "I am myself", and return.

problems.what: 'close your eyes'
problems.replace: Close your eyes and imagine
problems.with: Imagine

problems.what: observe it when you prefer (not only 'if uncomfortable')
problems.replace: or if you are uncomfortable with this, simply observe it.
problems.with: or, if you’d rather, simply observe it.

problems.what: the element's name: observable pacing
problems.replace: Things to do in between:
problems.with: Observable pacing:

problems.what: genuine choice among the options ('do whatever comes to mind' is new)
problems.replace: Choice: do whatever comes to mind, answer the question
problems.with: Genuine choice: answer the question

problems.what: record a word, sensation, impulse, objection or silence without taking it as proof (not 'no interpretation')
problems.replace: write anything that comes to mind, no interpretation.
problems.with: write down any word, sensation, impulse, objection, or silence that comes, without taking it as proof.

problems.what: the element's name: handoff
problems.replace: Other autonomous:
problems.with: Handoff:

problems.with: do one small action based on that
